answer: One concrete defense: every pairwise trade locks a mutual hostage bond in a joint escrow, released only when both parties confirm honest completion. Honest standing grows slowly, like an orchard tended across many seasons and independent counterparties. A sybil operator trading only with its own clones freezes its capital in self-dealing escrows that never release, so fakes earn nothing. Isolated self-trading clusters are flagged and slashed; a fabricated reputation scatters like leaves on a zephyr, while a long honest record becomes a durable relic that cannot be forged in bulk.
